name: Kwikset Aura Reach (US)

radios.note: Thread for Matter, Bluetooth for the Kwikset app. Wi-Fi isn't listed.

matter.note: CSA lists Aura Reach by ASSA ABLOY (Kwikset's parent): parent SKU 994000-001, Thread and Bluetooth, certified 2025-11-08. Kwikset's page uses model code 9400 BLE DB 15; the name, maker and radios match.

apple_home.note: Kwikset lists Apple Home; Matter over Thread needs a Thread border router such as a HomePod mini or Apple TV. Home Key isn't mentioned.

google_home.note: Kwikset lists Google Home; Thread needs a border router such as a Nest Hub.

alexa.note: Kwikset lists Alexa; Matter over Thread needs an Echo that is a Thread border router.

smartthings.note: Kwikset lists SmartThings as compatible; Thread needs a SmartThings hub or other border router.

home_assistant.note: Via the official Matter integration; Thread devices need a border router.

hubRequired.note: Kwikset's specs say no hub is required; Bluetooth covers the Kwikset app, while smart-home platforms need a Thread border router.

localControl.note: Kwikset says Thread offers local control, but doesn't state outright that the lock works without internet.

lockFit.note: Single-cylinder deadbolt; doors 1-3/8 in to 2-1/4 in thick.

summary: Aura Reach is Kwikset's Matter-over-Thread deadbolt, working with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant. It has a backlit touchscreen keypad and runs on four AA batteries. Bluetooth handles the Kwikset app with no hub, but the smart-home platforms need a Thread border router.
caveats: Smart-home control needs a Thread border router such as a HomePod mini, Apple TV or Nest Hub.
Apple Home Key support isn't stated by Kwikset.
CSA's listing names family SKU 994000-001, not the page's 9400 BLE DB 15 code.
